description: Fixed prompt set for the Claude-in-the-loop live e2e harness (evals/e2e_pipeline_harness.py, open-queue (p)). Covers the families that regressed in 0.2.18-0.2.21: single-series, two-series numeric, numeric+state overlay, long-window statistics tier, and the answer channel. Prompts use entities on the live allowlist (kitchen/basement ecobee temps, kitchen AC).

prompts.expect: codegen line chart, real data plotted, y-axis unit °F, no fallback

prompts.prompt: Show the basement temperature for the last 3 days
prompts.expect: codegen line chart, real data across ~3 days, °F axis (the 0.2.18 empty-chart + 'Value' regression case)

prompts.prompt: Show the kitchen and basement temperatures over the weekend
prompts.expect: two distinct lines with legend, °F axis (the 0.2.19 grounding + °C regression case)

prompts.prompt: Show the kitchen and basement temperatures over the last five days and when the AC was running
prompts.expect: numeric lines + shaded cooling bands via derived_intervals; NO state series drawn as a line (the 0.2.21 / ADR-0033 case)

prompts.prompt: Show the kitchen temperature over the last 60 days
prompts.expect: statistics-tier chart over ~60 days (not empty, not clipped to recorder retention)

prompts.prompt: What was the average kitchen temperature over the last week?
prompts.expect: chart + answer_text with a computed number; answer_verification present (verified or caveat, never a false verified)
